about: Retrieval parity set for the single-file stack (docs/SQLITE_PLAN.md). Memories a coding project would hold, questions worded differently from the stored text, and off-topic questions that should return nothing. Written by the reviewing agent on 2026-11-14; not independent gold.

memories.subject: tests
memories.value: make test-db (needs Postgres running)

memories.subject: deploys
memories.value: Production deploys happen every Thursday

memories.subject: code style
memories.value: black with a line length of 100

memories.subject: pull requests
memories.value: Start with the ticket key, e.g. 'WID-142: Fix login'

memories.subject: staging database
memories.value: widget_stage_07

memories.subject: python packages
memories.value: Always use uv, never pip

memories.subject: local services
memories.value: API 8081, worker 8090, admin UI 8095

memories.subject: test_sync_timeout
memories.value: Flaky because of an upstream bug; skip with -k 'not sync_timeout'

memories.subject: branches
memories.value: feature/<ticket>-<slug>, never commit directly to main

memories.subject: commits
memories.value: Conventional Commits; no AI co-author trailers

memories.subject: CI
memories.value: GitHub Actions is disabled; run make lint and make test-db locally before pushing

memories.subject: database migrations
memories.value: numbered raw SQL files in migrations/, never edit an applied one

memories.subject: secrets
memories.value: API keys live in the 1Password vault 'Widget Dev'; never put them in .env.example

memories.subject: logging
memories.value: structlog with JSON output in production

memories.subject: error tracking
memories.value: Sentry project widget-api

memories.subject: feature flags
memories.value: LaunchDarkly; flags are prefixed wid_

memories.subject: frontend
memories.value: Next.js 15 App Router with Tailwind

memories.subject: API
memories.value: JWT access tokens (15 min) with refresh tokens in httpOnly cookies

memories.subject: release manager
memories.value: Priya owns releases; ask her before tagging

memories.subject: on-call
memories.value: weekly, handoff on Mondays at 10am Central

memories.subject: code review
memories.value: two approvals for anything touching billing/

memories.subject: billing module
memories.value: payments team; do not refactor without asking Marco

memories.subject: Docker images
memories.value: ghcr.io/acme/widget

memories.subject: Kubernetes
memories.value: widget-prod and widget-staging on the acme-east cluster

memories.subject: background jobs
memories.value: Celery with Redis; long tasks go to the 'slow' queue

memories.subject: caching
memories.value: Redis, 5 minute default TTL, never cache user PII

memories.subject: type checking
memories.value: mypy strict on src/, not required for tests/

memories.subject: docstrings
memories.value: Google style, required for public functions

memories.subject: dependencies
memories.value: Renovate PRs are merged on Fridays

memories.subject: Python version
memories.value: 3.12 only

memories.subject: Node version
memories.value: 22 LTS, managed with fnm

memories.subject: database
memories.value: Postgres 16 with pgvector

memories.subject: ORM
memories.value: no ORM; raw SQL through asyncpg

memories.subject: performance budget
memories.value: p95 under 300 ms for /search

memories.subject: user
memories.value: prefers small diffs and one commit per milestone

memories.subject: user
memories.value: wants a recommendation, not a list of options

memories.subject: documentation
memories.value: architecture notes in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; update when schemas change

memories.subject: legacy importer
memories.value: deprecated; do not add features, scheduled for removal in Q1

memories.subject: rate limiting
memories.value: token bucket in Redis, 100 requests/min per API key

memories.subject: timezone handling
memories.value: store UTC, display in the user's timezone; never use naive datetimes
